seo.title: Partners — The IROKO Group and the supporters of WAHHF Foundation
seo.description: Discover the role of the IROKO Group, founding partner of WAHHF Foundation, and how to become a partner of the foundation.

title: Our partners and supporters
intro: WAHHF Foundation is supported by the IROKO Group, of which it is the social branch, and by its donors. No other partner is named without their written consent.

iroko.title: The IROKO Group, founding partner
iroko.p1: IROKO is a Cameroonian-German group organised around a holding company and nine business units, in three families: Business (communication and events, training, engineering), Digital (applications, management software, hosting) and Services and support (audiovisual, cybersecurity, investment). Its communication and events unit, IROKO Event, is up and running; the others have been announced.
iroko.p2: WAHHF Foundation is its social branch. The group funds the Language Academy (German/English/Italian A1 to C1) and the verified guidance materials for Europe.

cta.title: Become a partner of WAHHF Foundation
cta.subtitle: Do you represent a university, a training centre, an NGO, a medical facility or a committed company? Let’s build a programme with measurable impact together.
